description: Doomcaller's Circlet Level 60 Bring Vek'nilash's Circlet, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Vek'nilash's Circlet - Idol of Death x 2 - Silver Scarab x 5 - Bone Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
